description: List the organization's notification channels, to get the ids that channel_ids of monitors and heartbeats take: every member's own email channel, then up to 100 others (added email addresses first). Each has id, type, label, is_verified, is_active, state, member_name (the member whose own email channel it is, else null) and destination_hint (a masked email address, a chat id, or a webhook's scheme and host). state is WORKING, MUTED, PENDING_CONFIRMATION or BROKEN; only a WORKING channel receives alerts. An active channel can be bound in any state; a muted (inactive) or unknown id cannot be newly bound (404). Alerts go only to channels: if none works, the organization's owner is emailed. Channels are added and changed only in the dashboard.
name: list_channels
title: List notification channels
